article_content: At last, President Barack Obama has chosen to stop accommodating Senate Republicans and has moved forward with recess appointments for the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau director and National Labor Relations Board members. The GOP insists these actions set a troubling precedent, but they have themselves blocked countless presidential nominees, bringing us to this volatile moment. Democrats are not blameless, having obstructed nominations during President George W. Bush’s second term. Essentially, both parties have played the same game, even though Republicans have pushed stalling tactics to new extremes. Obama, meanwhile, held back for too long, hesitant to use his constitutionally granted power to make recess appointments. It is ironic to hear strict constructionists protest these moves, given that every president can constitutionally appoint individuals while the Senate is out of session. Critics appear to overlook the fact that Presidents George H.W. Bush and George W. Bush also employed recess appointments, including positions on the National Labor Relations Board. Ultimately, this is merely a partisan struggle. Each president should be able to bring in their preferred team. The U.S. Constitution calls for the Senate’s advice and consent, but it never intended for appointments to be stonewalled indefinitely. It is appalling when nominees must wait months or years simply to be confirmed or rejected. The Senate, mired in party disputes, fails repeatedly to act swiftly. With Obama currently in office, Republicans oppose what they label liberal judicial appointments, and when a Republican leads, Democrats knock conservative picks. Elections have ramifications; the winning party shapes judicial and executive appointees. Obama’s sharper stance against Congress represents a drastic departure from his earlier attempts to cooperate. While political harmony is laudable, the sheer number of blocked appointments shows the system is dysfunctional. Presidents should not appear weak or timid, but Obama has occasionally leaned toward caution with Congress. This tougher posture, combined with his more direct criticism of adversaries, has unexpectedly lifted his approval ratings and rallied his base. Some worry he will revert to a careful approach, yet in this climate, a strong leader must sometimes wield authority firmly. The GOP can complain about these recess appointments all day, but they are on shaky ground if they take legal action. Their unyielding opposition might keep Obama fired up and ready to act as necessary. That is the kind of changed perspective many seem prepared to support. The opinions presented are solely those of Roland S. Martin.
translated_content: În sfârșit, președintele Barack Obama a decis să nu mai facă concesii republicanilor din Senat și a avansat cu numirile pe durata vacanței pentru directorul Biroului pentru Protecția Financiară a Consumatorilor și membrii Consiliului Național pentru Relații de Muncă. Partidul Republican susține că aceste acțiuni stabilesc un precedent îngrijorător, dar ei înșiși au blocat nenumărați candidați prezidențiali, aducându-ne în acest moment delicat. Democrații nu sunt absolviți de vină, deoarece și ei au obstrucționat nominalizările în timpul celui de-al doilea mandat al președintelui George W. Bush. Practic, ambele partide au recurs la aceeași tactică, deși republicanii au dus tergiversarea la un nivel extrem. Între timp, Obama a ezitat prea mult, fiind reticent să-și exercite puterea constituțională pentru a face numiri pe durata vacanței. Este ironic să auzi adepții interpretării stricte a Constituției plângându-se de aceste mișcări, având în vedere că fiecare președinte are dreptul să facă numiri câtă vreme Senatul nu se află în sesiune. Criticii par să ignore faptul că președinții George H.W. Bush și George W. Bush au apelat și ei la astfel de numiri, inclusiv în Consiliul Național pentru Relații de Muncă. În definitiv, este doar o luptă partizană. Fiecare președinte ar trebui să-și poată alege echipa dorită. Constituția SUA prevede consultarea și consimțământul Senatului, dar nu urmărește să blocheze numirile la nesfârșit. Este revoltător când candidații așteaptă luni sau chiar ani doar pentru a fi aprobați sau respinși. Senatul, prins în disputele dintre partide, nu reacționează prompt. Cu Obama în funcție, republicanii se opun numirilor pe care le consideră prea liberale, iar când un republican este la Casa Albă, democrații dezaprobă nominalizările conservatoare. Alegerile au consecințe; partidul câștigător influențează nominalizările judecătorești și executive. Atitudinea mai fermă a lui Obama față de Congres reprezintă o schimbare majoră față de încercările sale anterioare de a coopera. Deși cooperarea politică ar fi ideală, numărul mare de nominalizări blocate arată cât de defectuos este sistemul. Președinții nu ar trebui să pară slabi sau ezitanți, dar Obama a acționat uneori cu precauție când a fost vorba de Congres. Această abordare mai hotărâtă, alături de criticile sale directe la adresa opozanților, i-a crescut în mod neașteptat nivelul de popularitate și a reușit să-și mobilizeze susținătorii. Unii se tem că va reveni la prudență, dar în acest climat, un lider puternic trebuie uneori să își exercite autoritatea cu fermitate. Republicanii pot critica tot timpul aceste numiri pe durata vacanței, însă se află pe teren instabil dacă vor să conteste decizia în justiție. Refuzul lor continuu de a coopera ar putea să-l țină pe Obama în priză, gata să reacționeze când este cazul. Aceasta este genul de schimbare de atitudine pe care mulți par să o susțină. Opiniile prezentate îi aparțin în exclusivitate lui Roland S. Martin.

article_content: (CNN) -- President Obama is prepared to send up to 300 military advisers to Iraq in a bid to stabilize a rapidly deteriorating situation. Obama had hoped that ending the Iraq war would be a key achievement of his administration. Yet just as he believed withdrawal was possible, he now finds himself drawn back into the conflict as violence spreads across Iraq. Aware that Americans have little appetite for another war, President Obama assures the nation that this mission will be contained. However, avoiding mission creep is notoriously difficult. History shows that even small-scale actions can evolve into major operations. The United States first entered the Korean peninsula to push North Korean forces out of South Korea, but President Harry Truman ended up overseeing a large-scale engagement that lasted three years, cost over 30,000 American lives, and contributed to his administration's downfall. Vietnam also began as a limited mission involving military advisers under Presidents Dwight Eisenhower and John F. Kennedy. Even after Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution under President Lyndon Johnson, it was not expected that the conflict would balloon, ultimately claiming nearly 60,000 U.S. lives and damaging America's international standing. Mission creep did not stop there. Under President George H.W. Bush, 30,000 troops were deployed to Somalia on a peacekeeping mission. After U.N. forces were attacked by a warlord, operations expanded, and President Clinton found himself escalating America's role. Although George H.W. Bush's objective was to remove Saddam Hussein from Kuwait in 1990 and 1991, maintaining a presence in the region after Saddam defied U.N. resolutions led to prolonged engagement. After 9/11, the United States dramatically expanded its operations in Afghanistan and Iraq, facing immense challenges in post-regime reconstruction. One reason for such expansions is that conflict involves many factors beyond the president's control. Allies can be unreliable and opponents can cause more trouble than anticipated, even with far fewer resources. An initially small mission can quickly escalate due to the inherent dangers of warfare. Domestic politics also influence escalation. Once troops are committed, political pressures often mount to go further, especially early in a conflict. Both parties aim to appear tough and avoid accusations of weakness, as in the aftermath of 1949 when some Republicans blamed Democrats for losing China to communism. Finally, many current missions involving U.S. troops lack clear objectives or definitions of victory, as seen in the war on terrorism. Efforts to establish stable governments that do not harbor terrorist networks or constantly fight fundamentalist forces often require ongoing involvement, which is neither quick nor limited. President Obama may hope that deploying advisers will swiftly achieve its purpose, but historical precedents suggest that mission creep can happen fast, potentially forcing him to send more troops than initially planned into the turmoil of Iraq.

Obama sperase că încheierea războiului din Irak va fi o realizare importantă a administrației sale. Totuși, exact când credea că retragerea era posibilă, se vede atras din nou în conflict, pe măsură ce violența se extinde în toată țara. Conștient că americanii au puțină dorință pentru un alt război, președintele Obama asigură națiunea că această misiune va fi limitată. Cu toate acestea, evitarea escaladării misiunii este notoriu de dificilă. Istoria arată că chiar și acțiunile la scară mică se pot transforma în operațiuni majore. Statele Unite au intrat inițial în Peninsula Coreeană pentru a respinge forțele nord-coreene din Coreea de Sud, dar președintele Harry Truman a ajuns să conducă o acțiune de anvergură care a durat trei ani, a costat peste 30.000 de vieți americane și a contribuit la căderea administrației sale. Și în Vietnam, totul a început ca o misiune limitată, cu consilieri militari sub președinții Dwight Eisenhower și John F. Kennedy. Chiar și după ce Congresul a adoptat Rezoluția Golful Tonkin sub președintele Lyndon Johnson, nu se aștepta ca acest conflict să se extindă atât de mult, ajungând să coste aproape 60.000 de vieți americane și să afecteze serios poziția internațională a Americii. Escaladarea misiunilor a continuat. Sub președintele George H.W. Bush, 30.000 de soldați au fost trimiși în Somalia într-o misiune de menținere a păcii. După ce forțele ONU au fost atacate de un lider militar local, operațiunile s-au extins, iar președintele Clinton a fost nevoit să intensifice rolul Americii. Deși obiectivul lui George H.W. Bush era să-l înlăture pe Saddam Hussein din Kuweit în 1990 și 1991, menținerea unei prezențe în regiune după ce Saddam a sfidat rezoluțiile ONU a dus la un angajament prelungit. După 9/11, Statele Unite și-au extins dramatic operațiunile în Afganistan și Irak, confruntându-se cu provocări uriașe în reconstrucția de după căderea regimurilor. Un motiv pentru aceste extinderi este că războiul implică numeroși factori care scapă controlului președintelui. Aliații pot fi nesiguri, iar inamicii pot cauza mai multe probleme decât se anticipa, chiar și cu resurse mult mai mici. O misiune inițial mică se poate amplifica rapid din cauza pericolelor inerente unei operațiuni militare. Și politica internă influențează escaladarea. Odată ce trupele sunt angajate, presiunile politice de a merge mai departe cresc, mai ales în fazele timpurii ale unui conflict. Ambele partide încearcă să pară ferme și să evite acuzațiile de slăbiciune, cum s-a întâmplat după 1949, când unii republicani au învinuit democrații că au pierdut China în fața comunismului. În cele din urmă, multe dintre misiunile actuale care implică trupe americane nu au obiective clare sau o definiție limpede a victoriei, așa cum se vede în războiul împotriva terorismului. Eforturile de a stabili guverne stabile, care să nu găzduiască rețele teroriste sau să lupte constant împotriva forțelor fundamentaliste, necesită implicare pe termen lung, ceea ce nu se face rapid sau în mod limitat. Președintele Obama poate spera că trimiterea de consilieri își va îndeplini rapid scopul, dar precedentele istorice arată că escaladarea misiunii poate surveni foarte repede, forțându-l, posibil, să trimită mai multe trupe decât și-a propus inițial în capcana din Irak.

article_content: Atletico Madrid will have Diego Simeone back on the touchline as they attempt to revive their Champions League campaign. His return to the dugout already proved decisive in the league on Saturday, suggesting Juventus could face a tough challenge. The bond between the Calderon crowd and their beloved 'El Cholo' has never been stronger, and his comeback from a six-match suspension helped secure a resounding 4-0 victory over Sevilla. Having served his European touchline ban, Simeone will be back on the bench against Juventus. Simeone’s name was sung before Saturday’s game, and as he took his seat, photographers crowded around him. True to form, the Argentine coach spent the match on his feet, gesturing and energizing his players with the same passion that has repeatedly put him at odds with officials. He was banned in domestic competition for tapping the fourth official on the back of the head during the Spanish Super Cup and in Europe for entering the pitch to confront Real Madrid’s Rafael Varane in the Champions League final. Without their talismanic manager, Atletico drew at home with Celta Vigo and then lost to Olympiacos in their first group match. Tonight, however, the team will be at full strength on and off the pitch when Juventus come to the Vicente Calderon. The Italian side beat Atalanta 3-0 at the weekend, maintaining their perfect record. Carlos Tevez and former Atletico youth player Alvaro Morata will likely feature up front. Simeone praised Tevez, calling him an extraordinary player who thrives close to goal and warning that Atletico must limit his time and space on the ball. Simeone’s return to domestic competition coincided with a 4-0 rout of Sevilla, and he confirmed that Miguel Moya would start in goal over Jan Oblak, who conceded three against Olympiacos. Captain Gabi looks set to miss out, so Koke will likely drop into central midfield alongside Tiago, supporting Raul Garcia, Arda Turan, and Antoine Griezmann. Determined to avoid further suspensions, Simeone admits he felt helpless in the stands during the loss in Greece, but says the team is ready for this crucial match against last year’s Champions League finalists. 'This is a final,' said Simeone, anticipating another vibrant atmosphere in Madrid as they host Italy’s strongest outfit. The former Inter Milan player also described facing Juventus in the Champions League as 'a final.'

Revenirea lui Simeone in competitia interna a coincis cu un 4-0 impotriva Sevillei, iar el a confirmat ca Miguel Moya va fi titular in poarta in locul lui Jan Oblak, care a primit trei goluri de la Olympiacos. Determinat sa evite noi suspendari, Simeone a recunoscut ca s-a simtit neputincios in tribune in timpul esecului din Grecia, dar spune ca echipa este pregatita pentru acest meci crucial impotriva finalistei de anul trecut. 'Este o finala', a declarat Simeone, anticipand o noua seara incendiara la Madrid, unde se confrunta cu cea mai puternica echipa din Italia. Fostul jucator al lui Inter Milano a descris intalnirea cu Juventus din Liga Campionilor tot ca 'o finala'.

article_content: Diego Costa, Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain and Edin Dzeko may all have found the net, but one West Brom midfielder outshone all three players in the Premier League this weekend. After two fierce derbies between Everton and Liverpool and Arsenal and Tottenham ended all square, Manchester City, Chelsea and Manchester United all earned three points. However, the biggest win of the week went to West Brom, who defeated Burnley 4-0 on Sunday. Here, EA Sports crunch the numbers to reveal the 10 best Premier League performers from the weekend. Baggies midfielder Graham Dorrans tops the charts, but who else makes the top 10 in their Player Performance Index (PPI)? West Brom duo Graham Dorrans and Saido Berahino made the top three of the Player's Performance Index. 10. Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, Arsenal (PPI score: 33.6) Oxlade-Chamberlain was among the Premier League's top ten performers this weekend, having rescued a point for Arsenal against arch-rivals Tottenham on Saturday. Besides his well-taken goal, Oxlade-Chamberlain completed four dribbles as the skilful wideman marauded forward with the ball while Arsenal tried to respond to Nacer Chadli's opener. Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain slides on his knees after scoring for Arsenal against rivals Tottenham on Saturday. The EA Sports PPI is the official player rating index of the Premier League. It measures a player's contribution to the success of his team. The intention is to remove any opinion bias and only work with proven statistical measurements, which become more accurate as the season progresses. So, what are the six indices? 1. Winning performance. 2. Player's performance per match. 3. Appearances. 4. Goals scored. 5. Assists. 6. Clean sheets. 9. Sergio Aguero, Man City (PPI score: 36.1) Aguero scored his fourth goal of the Premier League campaign so far as reigning champions Man City beat Hull 4-2 at the KC Stadium on Saturday. The Argentina international volleyed home after just seven minutes to give Manuel Pellegrini's men the lead before being substituted by Frank Lampard late in the second half, having completed four dribbles. 8. Craig Dawson, West Brom (PPI score: 36.7) The West Brom defender looks to have finally secured a place in the Baggies' first team under new manager Alan Irvine, having struggled for a regular starting berth since arriving at the Hawthorns from Rochdale in 2010. The centre-back scored his first-ever goal for the club in Sunday's 4-0 victory over Burnley with an accurately powered header. While finding the back of the net, Dawson made five interceptions and had a pass completion rate of 81.7 per cent. 7. Willian, Chelsea (PPI score: 38.3) Chelsea's Brazilian wideman scored one and assisted one during the Blues' 3-0 victory over Aston Villa on Saturday, as Jose Mourinho's side maintained their position at the top of the Premier League table. Willian made 41 passes in the Aston Villa half and had an impressive completion rate of 93.1 per cent. 6. Oscar, Chelsea (PPI score: 39.1) While Chelsea's attacking midfielder found himself on the scoresheet alongside fellow Brazilian Willian against Aston Villa, the Blues' No 8 was also useful at the other end of the pitch, making three clearances to help his side keep a clean sheet. Despite a worse pass completion rate (82.2 per cent), Oscar's defensive work sees him finish one place above Willian in the Player Performance Index chart. 5. Mile Jedinak, Crystal Palace (PPI score: 41.2) The Crystal Palace captain climbed highest to power a header past a sprawling Kasper Schmeichel, doubling the Eagles' lead against Leicester. The Australian's PPI score for the weekend is 41.2, having made six interceptions in the middle of the park during Saturday's 2-0 victory. 4. Diego Costa, Chelsea (PPI score: 44.6) The Chelsea striker scored his eighth Premier League goal of the campaign against Aston Villa, leading the scoring charts at the end of September. The Blues' frontman produced five shots at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon, four of which were on target. 3. Saido Berahino, West Brom (PPI score: 46.9) The 21-year-old striker scored a brace in West Brom's 4-0 win to double his own tally for the season. Berahino's display, including an 85 per cent pass success rate, sees the Baggies frontman take third in the Player Performance Index with a score of 46.9. 2. Edin Dzeko, Manchester City (PPI score: 50.2) Manchester City striker Edin Dzeko netted twice in his side's 4-2 win over Hull and subsequently earned a PPI score of 50.2. The Bosnian frontman also made three clearances in the win, as Manuel Pellegrini's men kept up with early leaders Chelsea. 1. Graham Dorrans, West Brom (PPI score: 51.0) Graham Dorrans takes top spot with a PPI score of 51, following his all-action display in West Brom's 4-0 victory over Burnley on Sunday. The Scottish midfielder made two assists to set the Baggies on their way before firing home in the final minute of the game to complete an impressive rout. The 27-year-old Glaswegian pipped Dzeko to first place, having made 45 passes in the opposition half. Data courtesy of the EA SPORTS Player Performance Index, the Official Player Rating index of the Barclays Premier League.

article_content: Published by Tammy Hughes on 8 June 2012 at 04:18 EST (updated at 08:27 EST), this article explores why George W. Bush remains the least popular living former U.S. president. Some speculate that the Iraq War, the global financial meltdown, or his shaky command of English contributed to his low approval ratings. Regardless of the cause, well over half of those surveyed have an unfavorable opinion of him, according to a newly released CNN poll showing that only 43% view Bush positively, while 54% do not. In contrast, Bill Clinton receives high marks from roughly two-thirds of Americans, as reported by The Huffington Post. Barack Obama has seized upon Bush's lingering unpopularity during the campaign season, repeatedly attributing the economic slump, growing federal debt, and uncompleted military engagements to Bush's presidency. CNN Polling Director Keating Holland indicates that reminding voters of Bush may help Obama's re-election efforts, noting that some individuals appear more optimistic about their current finances when Bush is mentioned. Additionally, the poll's findings support Obama's decision to recruit Clinton for campaigning on behalf of Democrats navigating tough election contests nationwide.

Prin contrast, Bill Clinton se bucură de aprecierea a aproximativ două treimi dintre americani, conform relatării din The Huffington Post. În plus, concluziile sondajului susțin decizia lui Obama de a-l implica pe Clinton în campania pentru democrații care se confruntă cu curse electorale dificile la nivel național.

article_content: (CNN) -- The nation's new 'first dog' has generated a surge of interest in Portuguese water dogs, but it doesn't necessarily mean everyone understands the breed's needs, according to two owners and breeders interviewed by CNN. Bo, the Portuguese water dog, was a gift from Senator Ted Kennedy to the Obama girls, and this moment has brought unprecedented attention to the breed. 'This is the most publicity Portuguese water dogs have ever had since they were introduced to the U.S. in the late 1960s,' stated the Portuguese Water Dog Club of America in a press release, noting that its website was receiving up to a million hits an hour. After President Obama and his family welcomed Bo into the White House, club member Susan Teasley said, 'People are calling more often, wanting to know about the breed, which is good, but water dogs aren't for everyone.' Fellow breeder Jane Harding reported about a 10 percent increase in calls, adding that Portuguese water dogs are 'active athletes' rather than laid-back couch companions. 'They can be destructive if left alone,' Teasley explained. 'They want to be with you at all times, even if you're in the bathroom or in bed. They're certainly not apartment dogs.' Harding joked that for owners seeking a dog that can live tied up or quietly in an apartment, 'we recommend a stuffed dog.' She emphasized that Portuguese water dogs love the outdoors and can eat from gardens if left unsupervised. Both breeders referenced the 'Dalmatian syndrome,' where many people rushed to get Dalmatians after '101 Dalmatians' was released in 1996, unaware of issues like excessive shedding and hearing problems. They believe the Obamas will succeed because they have 'access to the best trainers' and genuinely want to make things work with Bo. However, breeders encourage potential owners to do thorough research and find a mentor before getting a Portuguese water dog.
translated_content: (CNN) -- Noul 'prim-câine' al țării a stârnit un val de interes pentru câinii de apă portughezi, dar asta nu înseamnă neapărat că toți înțeleg necesitățile rasei, conform a doi proprietari și crescători intervievați de CNN. Bo, câinele de apă portughez, a fost un cadou oferit de senatorul Ted Kennedy fetelor familiei Obama, iar acest moment a atras o atenție fără precedent asupra rasei. 'Aceasta este cea mai mare expunere mediatică pentru câinii de apă portughezi de la introducerea lor în SUA, la sfârșitul anilor '60', a declarat Clubul Câinilor de Apă Portughezi din America, menționând că site-ul său primea până la un milion de vizite pe oră. După ce președintele Obama și familia sa l-au primit pe Bo la Casa Albă, membra clubului, Susan Teasley, a spus: 'Oamenii sună mai des, vor să afle despre rasă, ceea ce e bine, însă câinii de apă nu sunt pentru toată lumea.' Crescătoarea Jane Harding a raportat și ea o creștere de aproximativ 10% a apelurilor, adăugând că acești câini sunt 'atleți activi' mai degrabă decât tovarăși leneși de canapea. 'Pot fi distructivi dacă sunt lăsați singuri', a explicat Teasley. 'Vor să fie cu tine mereu, chiar și dacă ești la baie sau în pat. În mod cert, nu sunt câini de apartament.' Harding a glumit că, pentru cei care doresc un câine care poate sta legat sau trăi liniștit într-un apartament, 'recomandăm un câine de pluș.' Ea a subliniat că acești câini adoră timpul petrecut în aer liber și, dacă nu sunt supravegheați, pot ajunge să mănânce din grădină. Ambele crescătoare au menționat 'sindromul dalmațienilor', când, după lansarea filmului '101 Dalmațieni' în 1996, mulți entuziaști au cumpărat dalmațieni fără să știe de problemele precum năpârlirea excesivă și pierderea auzului. Ele cred că familia Obama va avea succes pentru că are 'acces la cei mai buni dresori' și își dorește cu adevărat să se descurce bine cu Bo. Cu toate acestea, crescătoarele îi încurajează pe cei interesați să se informeze și să-și găsească un mentor înainte de a adopta un câine de apă portughez.
